input: Create a personal brand style guide

gold.taskTitle: Build a Personal Brand Style Guide
gold.taskDescription: Create a cohesive personal brand style guide that defines the visual, verbal, and strategic elements of the user's personal brand.

questions.title: What is the primary purpose of your personal brand?
questions.description: Understanding whether the brand is for job searching, freelancing, thought leadership, social media growth, or another goal will shape the entire guide.

questions.title: Who is the specific audience you are targeting?
questions.description: Knowing the exact audience — recruiters, potential clients, followers in a niche, etc. — determines tone, style, and messaging direction.

questions.title: Which platforms will this brand appear on?
questions.description: Identifying the platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website, YouTube, etc.) affects format requirements, visual specs, and content priorities.

questions.title: Do you already have any existing brand elements to keep?
questions.description: Determining whether there is an existing logo, color palette, fonts, or bio that must be retained avoids rework and anchors the new guide.

questions.title: What three words should your brand make people feel?
questions.description: Capturing the intended emotional impression (e.g., bold, trustworthy, creative) establishes the tone for both visual and written guidelines.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing the style guide?
questions.description: Knowing the target completion date allows the plan to be broken into realistic milestones and prioritized correctly.

questions.title: Will you design the visuals yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Clarifying whether design work is done personally (using tools like Canva or Figma) or outsourced determines the steps, costs, and timeline involved.
